# Clipper2 (vendored)

Polygon clipping and offsetting by Angus Johnson, Boost Software License 1.0
(see LICENSE.txt). Copied unchanged from
https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2 at commit 4be4655 (2026-10-29,
version 2.0.1): `CPP/Clipper2Lib/include` and `CPP/Clipper2Lib/src`.

RePaint only talks to it through `RePaint/Slicer/Engine/ClipperBridge.h`.
To update: replace `include/` and `src/` with the same folders from a newer
commit and change the commit above.
